title: STEP: A Modular Silent Trial Engine for Operational Evaluation of Digital Pathology AI in Routine Workflow
abstract: arXiv:2608.28708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prospective silent trials provide an important bridge between retrospective validation of artificial intelligence (AI) models and their use in clinical care by evaluating model performance and operational reliability on live clinical data without influencing patient management. In computational pathology, conducting silent trials requires integration across laboratory information systems, digital pathology infrastructure, computational resources, and model inference pipelines, and these workflows are often implemented using application-specific software. We developed the Silent Trial Engine for Pathology (STEP), a reusable software platform for orchestrating prospective silent trials of computational pathology AI models across heterogeneous clinical and computational environments. translated_title: STEP：用于在常规工作流程中对数字病理学AI进行运行评估的模块化静默试验引擎
translated_abstract: 前瞻性静默试验通过在不影响患者管理的情况下，在真实临床数据上评估模型性能和运行可靠性，为人工智能（AI）模型的回顾性验证与其在临床护理中的实际应用之间搭建了重要桥梁。在计算病理学中，开展静默试验需要整合实验室信息系统、数字病理学基础设施、计算资源和模型推理管道，而这些工作流程通常需要使用特定应用的软件来实现。我们开发了病理学静默试验引擎（STEP），这是一个可复用的软件平台，用于在异构的临床和计算环境中协调计算病理学AI模型的前瞻性静默试验。STEP通过模块化适配器接口，将通用的试验编排功能与特定机构的数据访问和计算基础设施相分离。该平台……
tldr: 研究团队开发了可复用的模块化软件平台STEP，通过适配器接口将静默试验的通用编排功能与各机构特定的数据访问和计算基础设施解耦，从而支持计算病理学AI模型在异构临床环境中开展前瞻性静默试验。
en_tdlr: The authors developed STEP, a reusable modular software platform that decouples common trial orchestration from institution-specific data access and compute infrastructure through adapter interfaces, enabling prospective silent trials of computational pathology AI models across heterogeneous clinical environments.
